statements.text: With the same amount of water, the flat cloth on the sunny sill dries faster than the crumpled cloth in the cool cupboard.
Warmth and a larger surface open to air both help water evaporate faster.
Water on the cloth cannot evaporate at all until the cloth reaches boiling temperature.

stem:
Ishaan spreads a wet cloth flat on a sunny sill. He also leaves an identical wet cloth crumpled in a cool cupboard.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: More exposed surface and higher temperature speed evaporation. Boiling is not required for evaporation near room temperature.
